core_eps_growth.what_changed: Core EPS growth cut to +2.5% to +3.5%, from the low end of +5% to +7%.
core_eps_growth.why_it_matters: A two-to-three point EPS reset late in the year signals cost pressure the revenue raise is not covering; peer staples models anchored on mid-single-digit EPS need a second look.

core_cc_eps_growth.what_changed: Core constant-currency EPS growth cut to +1% to +2%, from the low end of +4% to +6%.
core_cc_eps_growth.why_it_matters: Strip out FX and underlying earnings growth is now roughly flat, the cleanest read on operating pressure.

organic_revenue_growth.what_changed: Organic revenue narrowed to about +3%, the midpoint of +2% to +4%.
organic_revenue_growth.why_it_matters: Top-line momentum is holding; the miss is in margins, not demand.

net_revenue_growth.what_changed: Reported net revenue growth now about +6%.
net_revenue_growth.why_it_matters: FX and mix lift reported sales, which flatters the top line versus organic.

core_tax_rate.what_changed: Core tax rate lowered to about 21% from about 22%.
core_tax_rate.why_it_matters: A lower tax rate props up EPS, so the operating cut is deeper than the headline.

north_america_margin.what_changed: North America margin pressure continues into Q4.
north_america_margin.why_it_matters: The largest profit pool stays under pressure, so Q4 risk sits in the US business.

outlook_next_year.why_it_matters: No 2027 anchor yet, so consensus will set it; expect estimate dispersion.
